hostname.description: Hostname for local discovery; also used as a client identifier. Defaulted rather than required: a field with no default aborts the parse before any other default is applied, so requiring it would make an empty section yield a zeroed struct rather than a working one.

instancename.description: Instance name used for local discovery

known_networks.description: Prioritized list of networks to attempt connection to

ap_ssid.description: SSID of the access point served when no known network is reachable

ap_password.description: Passphrase for that access point; WPA2 requires at least 8 characters

ap_max_connections.description: Maximum simultaneous clients in AP mode

ap_hidden.description: Hide the AP SSID from scans

connection_timeout_ms.description: Timeout for station mode connection attempt (ms)

scan_interval_ms.description: Longest wait between reconnect scans when disconnected (ms). Retries start at reconnect_delay_ms and double up to this.

reconnect_delay_ms.description: Wait before the first reconnect scan after losing the link (ms). Each further attempt doubles it, up to scan_interval_ms.

power_save.description: Station modem power saving (WIFI_PS_MIN_MODEM). Off by default: the radio sleeps between DTIM beacons, which saves power on a battery but costs missed beacons and latency on a marginal link.

roaming.description: Advertise 802.11k radio measurement and 802.11v BSS transition support, so an access point can steer the station to a better one on the same SSID. Takes effect only with CONFIG_ESP_WIFI_11KV_SUPPORT enabled.

reachability_host.description: Host to ping to confirm the link actually carries traffic. Empty disables the check. An associated station with a DHCP lease can still be unable to reach anything.

password.description: WPA2 passphrase; empty string for open networks

priority.description: Higher value = preferred when multiple known networks are visible
